origin.prompt: Purpose: tileable wood texture for 3D toy building blocks on a landing page, applied to cubes and planks at small size. Subject: planed natural maple wood, the face of a classic wooden building block. Scene: a flat, evenly lit sample of wood seen straight on, filling the whole frame edge to edge. Look: fine, straight, tight grain running horizontally, satin unfinished surface, pale honey tone, subtle ray flecks, no knots or defects, soft shadowless light so the texture can be relit in 3D. Composition: orthographic top-down view, uniform density across the frame so it tiles seamlessly. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no objects, no edges or borders.
